article.story: SAN FRANCISCO -- — Jorge Diaz Graham scored 18 points off of the bench to help lead Oregon State past San Francisco 90-63 on Thursday night. Diaz Graham also had five rebounds for the Beavers (14-13, 7-7 West Coast Conference). Isaiah Sy and Dez White each had 17 points. Ryan Beasley led the way for the Dons (14-13, 6-8) with 17 points. Legend Smiley added 14 points and Vukasin Masic had 11 points. Oregon State took the lead with 19:34 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Sy led his team in scoring with 13 points in the first half to help put them up 50-28 at the break. Oregon State pulled away with a 13-0 run in the second half to extend a 15-point lead to 28 points. Diaz Graham led the way with a team-high 13 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
